s0-tp8-v0.34 (TTFT ≤ 2 s, TPOT ≤ 10 ms): met, but not with 95 % confidence (a p99's upper bound is above the target, or the windows had too few requests to bound it): a longer measurement may confirm a lower rate.

TTFT ≤ 2 s, TPOT ≤ 50 ms: recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009 serves the most per GPU (626 output tok/s against s0-tp8-v0.34's 404), but its users get 35 tokens/s against 61. At 61 tokens/s per user, recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009 serves about 392, no more than s0-tp8-v0.34: compare them at the same speed per user, not only at the same target.

TTFT ≤ 2 s, TPOT ≤ 30 ms: recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009 serves the most per GPU (526 output tok/s against s0-tp8-v0.34's 381), but its users get 43 tokens/s against 78. At 78 tokens/s per user, recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009 serves about 266, no more than s0-tp8-v0.34: compare them at the same speed per user, not only at the same target.

recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009: the capacity was measured with quick settings (60 s confirmation windows, 2 repeats). Longer windows meet more of the rare slow requests, so a full measurement (--window 600 --repeats 5) can confirm a lower rate: plan with headroom.

reproduce.what: Check the node, with the GPUs free

reproduce.command: econ report /hpelustre/krai/krai_gentic/econ/exp4/recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009_j55021/measure/measure.json /hpelustre/krai/krai_gentic/econ/exp3/s0-tp8-v0.34_j50319/measure/measure.json --check /hpelustre/krai/krai_gentic/econ/exp4/recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009_j55021/check/check.json --prices /hpelustre/krai/krai_gentic/econ/exp4/prices_deepseek-v4.1-flash_2026-11-23.json --rent 5.29 --rent 3.59 --title econ 0.0.9 on an H200 node: vLLM's recipe (TP4) and S0 on stock vLLM 0.34.0 --out /hpelustre/krai/krai_gentic/econ/exp4/recipe-tp4-v0.34-e009_j55021/report --html

method: Open-loop Poisson arrivals at a fixed rate; the rate grows until a probe misses the target, then bisects, then the best rate is confirmed over full windows. TTFT counts from the request's send (queueing included); TPOT per request is (last token - first token) / (output tokens - 1); a failed request is an infinite latency. Requests keep arriving until the last measured one finishes, so the load stays steady for all of them. Power is nvidia-smi's GPU board power every second, averaged over each window; Power and energy says what else was counted.

Node check (econ check): nvidia-smi's state of each GPU, then probes with torch on every GPU at once (8,192-square BF16 matmuls, a device-to-device copy, a copy from pinned host memory) sampled every 0.5 s; a probe's reference is the datasheet times the share a healthy H200 reaches, and it passes from 80 % of it.

Stability: nvidia-smi every second over the whole measurement (power, SM clock, temperature, utilisation, clock-event reasons and, from econ 0.0.6, the PCIe link), with each GPU's state at the start and the end; under load means at 50 % utilisation or above.

Power and energy: nvidia-smi samples every GPU of the node every second. The serving GPU boards give the configuration's own tokens per joule; every board, the CPU packages (RAPL), the NvSwitches (DCGM, each one's three rails) and a node meter (ACPI), where readable, give what the node drew, and only a meter makes it the node's.
